objections.claim_attacked: chosen_intervention: attribution of both the 0.2 layer adjustment and 35 congestion iterations to the quoted support
objections.objection: The supplied direct_quote supports changing the routing-layer adjustment from 0.45 to 0.2, but it does not itself support the accompanying claim that congestion iterations were set to 35. The longer quotation embedded in chosen_intervention asserts both, but the separately structured quote evidence preserves only the first sentence. A correct version would either provide a direct quote that includes the 35-iteration statement or distinguish the iteration setting as an unquoted thread assertion.

mechanism_check: The intervention is mechanically plausible on this record: if the 0.45 routing-layer adjustment reserves/derates enough routing capacity to cause excessive global-route overflow, reducing it to 0.2 can make more capacity available and permit GRT to finish; additional congestion iterations can also give the router more opportunity to resolve overflow. However, because both parameters changed together, the record does not isolate their individual effects. The macro-loop hypothesis remains a separate, unresolved possible contributor, so the record supports a workaround/configuration result rather than a demonstrated root-cause fix.
evidence_check: post_state is merely asserted, not measured. What is reported is that GRT could finish/complete BoomTile after the stated parameter changes. A closed-out fix claim would need at minimum the resulting congestion/overflow or DRC count, reproducible run configuration and version, and preferably runtime plus confirmation that the macro-loop pathology no longer occurs or is irrelevant under the new settings.
attribution_check: The direct_quote is attributed to a named participant, eder-matheus, and includes both a date and issue locator. It directly supports the 0.45-to-0.2 adjustment claim. It does not, as structured here, directly support the 35-iteration portion of chosen_intervention; that support is incomplete unless the omitted second sentence is independently retained as quote evidence.
missing_from_story: The exact post-change routing result: remaining overflow/congestion or DRC count, and whether the original approximately 20k count was eliminated, reduced, or merely bypassed sufficiently for GRT to terminate.
A controlled comparison separating the effect of changing layer adjustment from increasing iterations from 30 to 35.

The precise configuration scope of the 0.45 and 0.2 adjustment values, including which routing layers they apply to and whether the change affects routability, design-rule risk, or only router capacity assumptions.
Whether the separate macro-loop behavior in issue #5971 persisted after the configuration change, making this an operational workaround rather than a resolution of the suspected pathology.
